title: AWS Cloud Architect
text: Investment bank (fictional) is hiring an AWS Cloud Architect in Gurgaon. Experience: 12-18 years. Budget up to 45 LPA, notice period 30 days maximum. Mandatory: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, networking, security, cloud migration and disaster recovery. Nice to have: Azure, Python scripting, AWS certifications. You will design landing zones, lead migrations of core banking workloads and define DR runbooks.

title: Senior Java Backend Developer
text: Senior Java Backend Developer, Pune (hybrid). 5 to 8 years of experience. Must have: Java 17, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, PostgreSQL and Kafka. Good to have: Docker, AWS, Redis. Build payment services handling high volumes; own code reviews and production support. Immediate joiners preferred, notice up to 60 days.

title: Data Engineer
text: We need a Data Engineer in Bengaluru with 4-7 years experience. Required skills: Python, SQL, Apache Spark, Airflow, and a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake or BigQuery). Desirable: dbt, Kafka, Terraform. You will build batch and streaming pipelines and data quality checks for the analytics team.

title: Salesforce Developer
text: Salesforce Developer - Hyderabad. 3-6 yrs. Must: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, Salesforce integrations (REST/SOAP) and Sales Cloud. Plus: Service Cloud, Platform Developer I certification. Work with business analysts to deliver CRM features in two-week sprints.

title: SAP FICO Consultant
text: SAP FICO Consultant for a manufacturing client in Noida. 8-12 years of SAP FI/CO experience with at least two end-to-end S/4HANA implementations. Mandatory: SAP FI, SAP CO, S/4HANA, General Ledger, Asset Accounting and integration with SD/MM. Nice: SAP Activate, client-facing workshops. Travel 20%.
